parameters.content:
## YouTube Competitor Idea Miner

### How it works

This workflow scans competitor YouTube channels on a weekly schedule or from a manual form submission, reads each channel’s RSS feed, and filters out videos that have already been processed. For each new candidate video, it uses Gemini to generate content ideas, scores them, saves high-scoring ideas to Google Sheets, and records every processed video as seen. After the candidate loop finishes, it builds a run summary and emails an idea digest when there are reportable ideas.

### Setup steps

- Configure the schedule trigger and/or form trigger inputs for how scans should be started.
- Update the scan configuration with competitorChannelIds, maxVideosPerChannel, maxCandidatesPerRun, and ideaScoreThreshold.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and configure the sheets/ranges used for seen video IDs, saved ideas, and processed video records.
- Connect Google Gemini credentials for the AI idea-generation chain and verify the prompt/model settings.
- Connect Gmail credentials and set the digest email recipient, sender, and subject details.

### Customization

Adjust the competitor channel list, scoring threshold, candidate limits, AI prompt, and email digest format to match the niche and publishing strategy.

## Start scan configuration

Starts the workflow from either the weekly schedule or form submission, then sets the scan parameters used by the rest of the run.

## Load seen videos

Reads the existing seen-video registry from Google Sheets so later steps can avoid reprocessing the same competitor uploads.

## Fetch channel videos

Splits the configured competitor channel list, loops through each channel, fetches its YouTube RSS feed, and parses the feed into video records.

## Build candidate queue

Combines all parsed channel videos, removes duplicates and already-seen items, then checks whether there are any new videos to process.

## No new videos path

Ends the run cleanly when the scan finds no new competitor videos.

## Generate AI ideas

Splits the candidate queue, loops over each candidate video, sends it to Gemini for idea generation, and parses the AI response before continuing the loop.

## Filter and save ideas

Checks whether each generated idea meets the score threshold, saves qualifying ideas to Google Sheets, and skips low-scoring ideas.

## Mark videos seen

Builds a seen-video record for each processed candidate and writes it to Google Sheets so future scans can ignore it.

## Prepare run digest

After all candidates are processed, builds the run summary, decides whether there are ideas worth reporting, prepares the email body, or exits if nothing should be sent.

## Send digest email

Sends the prepared idea digest through Gmail to notify the user about the best new content opportunities.
